sermons.title: Understanding Grace
summary: Grace is God's unmerited empowerment to live above sin.
You cannot mix law and grace — they operate on different principles.
Grace teaches, empowers, and produces holiness in the believer.

sermons.title: How Faith Works
summary: Faith is the substance of things hoped for — it gives evidence in the unseen realm.
Faith comes by hearing, then hearing, then hearing the Word.
Believe it in the heart, speak it with the mouth, act like it is done.
